The exponential backoff with jitter addresses bursty network contention, preventing cascading failures. The quality floor acts as a gatekeeper, ensuring that only sufficiently informed picks reach users, thus maintaining a trust barrier. Together, they embody a dual commitment to availability (via retries) and consistency (via quality checks and persistence), which is essential for a high-stakes prediction platform where missing a signal can be as costly as receiving noise.
